name: Solana

sdk_migration.notes: The Solana Foundation and Anza are actively migrating the ecosystem from @solana/web3.js (v1.x) to @solana/kit (the new zero-dependency SDK). Any community skill or tutorial referencing @solana/web3.js without a migration note should be treated as potentially outdated. The migration skill 'solana-kit-migration-skill' exists to guide this transition.

philosophy: Protocol-specific and performance-first. Skills and tools map 1:1 to protocols with no unification abstraction layer. Every design decision optimizes for transaction throughput and cost.
agent_assumptions: Agents interface directly with protocols. No abstraction layer is assumed between agent and DEX or indexing infrastructure. Agent tooling is protocol-specific, not chain-generic.
